username.description: SIP username (local part of SIP URI); leave blank if not using default account

displayname.description: Caller ID / display name shown on outgoing calls

accounts.description: List of SIP accounts (one per line or block)

display_name.description: Human-readable name for this account (used in comments)

uri.description: Full SIP URI of the account (e.g., sip:user@domain.com)

transport.description: Preferred transport: udp, tcp, tls (leave blank to auto-select)

register.description: Whether to register this account with the registrar

rtp_ipv6.description: Prefer IPv6 for RTP media (if available)

rtp_force_ipv4.description: Force IPv4 for RTP media (disable IPv6)

sips_contact.description: SIPS contact URI to use (e.g., sips:me@proxy.example.com)

audio_device.description: Audio input/output device list (comma-separated; e.g., 'pulse,alsa' or 'oss,/dev/dsp')

audio_sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz (0 = auto-detect)

audio_channels.description: Audio channels (0 = mono, 1 = mono, 2 = stereo; 0 = auto)

audio_buffer_size.description: Audio buffer size in milliseconds (0 = default)

video_size.description: Video resolution in width x height (e.g., '320x240', '640x480', '1280x720')

video_bitrate.description: Video encoder bitrate in bits per second

natpmp_enabled.description: Enable NAT-PMP for port mapping (router must support)

upnp_enabled.description: Enable UPnP for automatic port forwarding

modules.description: List of baresip modules to load

config.description: Optional module-specific configuration line (e.g., 'device=0' for aufile)

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format)

tls_cafile.description: Path to CA certificates bundle (PEM format)

tls_verify_server.description: Verify server certificate during TLS handshake (for outbound TLS)
